method.algorithm: Exact-line longest common subsequence (LCS) over UTF-8 decoded Markdown content returned by GitHub Contents API.
method.note: Diff counts include whitespace-only and markup/front-matter changes; they are not counts of changed factual statements.

observed_differences.detail: Initial front matter is indented and image_feature is empty; later version normalizes front-matter spacing and sets image_feature to the existing lead image URL.
HTML paragraph alignment wrappers around the author/editor/photo credits and around the standalone '艾芬' label were removed or simplified.

inference_limits: This compares two revisions within the Terminus GitHub repository only.
It does not compare Terminus against the yyrw.org.cn version or the original Renwu WeChat post.
The GitHub-signed commit timestamp establishes repository commit metadata, not original publication time or the first existence of any copy.
The comparison does not independently authenticate claims inside the interview.
